I don't read, I listen! The secret is to only listen to books that solve a problem you're facing right now. It keeps you hooked while you commute or do chores. It's also the easiest way to become a regular reader. The Library has 110+ audio summaries, so you can pick the one that fits your problem today:
👉 https://littlebitbetter.gumroad.com/l/mmenh

✍️ I LIKE YOUR WHITEBOARD ANIMATIONS. HOW DO YOU MAKE THEM?

👉 https://littlebitbetter-playbook.web.app/

🤖 WHICH AI TOOLS DO YOU USE?
None! Everything is crafted from scratch by me and my team. We have been producing videos this way since 2016—no shortcuts, just pure human creativity.
